parameters.name: DestCidrBlockList
parameters.description: The list of destination CIDR blocks of routes.

parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route. Both IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks are supported.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the IP protocol. Valid values:

- **ipv4**: IPv4.

- **ipv6**: IPv6.

parameters.name: MaxResult
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextHopId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the next hop.

parameters.name: NextHopType
parameters.description:
The next hop type. Valid values:

- **Instance** (default): ECS instance.

- **HaVip**: high-availability virtual IP address.

- **VpnGateway**: VPN gateway.

- **NatGateway**: NAT gateway.

- **NetworkInterface**: secondary elastic network interface controller (NIC).

- **RouterInterface**: routing interface.

- **IPv6Gateway**: IPv6 gateway.

- **Attachment**: transit router.
- **Ipv4Gateway**: IPv4 gateway.
- **GatewayEndpoint**: gateway endpoint.
- **Ecr**: Express Connect Router (ECR).

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- If this is the first request or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
- If a subsequent query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the route table to which the route belongs.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouteEntryId
parameters.description: The ID of the route that you want to query.

parameters.name: RouteEntryName
parameters.description:
The name of the route.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RouteEntryType
parameters.description:
The type of the route. Valid values:

- **Custom**: custom route.
- **System**: system route.
- **BGP**: BGP route.
- **CEN**: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
- **ECR**: Express Connect Router (ECR) route.

parameters.name: RouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table that you want to query.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The type of route hosting. If this field is empty, the route is not hosted.

Valid values: **TR**, which indicates that the hosting type is transit router.
